objectives.text: Find the card with two black diamonds that is 3 tiles from a tree that is 5 tiles from a short grey house.
Find the card with one green square that is 2 tiles from a short grey house that is next to another short grey house.
Find the card with one red heart that is next to a short green house that is 2 tiles from a short grey house.
Find the card with one green circle that is 2 tiles from a short grey house that is 2 tiles from a short green house.
Find the card with one blue star that is beside a short grey house that is beside a short yellow house.
Find the card with one black square that is next to a short green house that is 4 tiles from a tall blue house.
Find the card with two orange diamonds that is next to a tall grey house that is 3 tiles from a tall blue house.
Find the card with one black diamond that is beside a short green house that is beside a short red house.
Find the card with two black circles that is beside a short green house that is next to a short red house.
Find the card with two blue stars that is 2 tiles from a short grey house that is 3 tiles from another short grey house.
Find the card with two red diamonds that is 3 tiles from a short green house that is next to a short red house.
Find the card with one red square that is next to a short blue house that is next to a tall blue house.
Find the card with one black heart that is 2 tiles from a short grey house that is 2 tiles from a short green house.
Find the card with one orange square that is 3 tiles from a short grey house that is beside another short grey house.
Find the card with one red star that is beside a short grey house that is next to a short yellow house.
